description: `p1` has its own `model:` and a profile `model:` override (the profile's value wins); `p2` has no `model:` of its own, so it still resolves the document default; `t1` (a tool) has only a profile `model:` override. Proves `meta.model`, `model_reason: "explicit"` on `p1`, `fallback_attempts[].model`, and the tool's own `meta.params_rendered.model`.
